content: Restart-policy decision (planned, NOT yet implemented): align ALL units to Chimera's restart semantics — dinit compiled/built with --default-auto-restart=on-failure equivalent per-unit: dbus-activated on-demand daemons get restart=on-failure (crash-only restart, clean idle exit = unit stops until next dbus activation); boot-enabled long-running daemons keep smooth-recovery=true + restart=on-failure; one-shots stay restart=false. Alpine's stock dinit build defaults restart=ALWAYS (upstream configure default) — that is WHY idle-exit daemons loop. Evidence: systemd Restart= default=no; upstream polkit unit has NO Restart=; upower/TLP use Restart=on-failure; Chimera dinit template.py --default-auto-restart=on-failure; Artix elogind smooth-recovery=true + dbus smooth-recovery=no. Also: Alpine dinit has NO explicit default-auto-restart in APKBUILD (community/dinit prepare() runs plain configure). Full sweep of all units to be executed in a dedicated round; signon-ui churn (smooth-recovery=true + restart=always default = 42 restarts/20min proven) is the motivating case.

Restart-policy sweep EXECUTED (decision round + research): 144 unit files in 108 packages edited in aports — boot/session long-running daemons = smooth-recovery=true kept + restart=on-failure explicit; dbus-activated on-demand (idle-exit capable: signon-ui x2, fwupd, cups-pk-helper, secretprompter + the smooth=false geoclue/fprintd/kauth/EDS/GNOME apps class) = restart=on-failure + smooth-recovery=false; one-shots restart=false verified; getty restart=true special; dms.user FLIPPED to smooth=false (latent greeter-loop bug: its greeter-guard clean exit respawned DMS forever — harness autologin never exposed it). Root cause of churn: Alpine dinit builds STOCK = restart=ALWAYS (upstream configure default, no --default-auto-restart flag) — every unit without explicit restart restarted on clean exits too. systemd default=no; Chimera builds on-failure; upstream polkit no Restart=; upower/TLP on-failure. aports CI: 6 failed runs before green — DMS upstream RENAMED (DankMaterialShell -> duxlabs-dev/dux-shell + dank-qml-common -> dux-qml-common, v1.6.2 re-published) — sources repinned bytes-identical; lesson: tag archives NOT immutable, pin by commit. NEW product bug in backlog: xdg-desktop-portal-dinit runs the WRONG binary (permission-store instead of portal frontend). Validated: niriWayle 2026-11-08T15-57-09Z 118/118 ALL PASS (log_errors clean).

dinit restart-policy principle (FeralOS house rule now): dbus-activated on-demand daemons (idle-exit by design) = restart=on-failure + smooth-recovery=false — the next dbus call IS their restart mechanism; smooth-recovery=true + Alpine's stock restart=always default = infinite restart loop on clean exits (restart limiter 3/10s never catches slow 30s cycles). Boot-enabled resident daemons = smooth-recovery=true + restart=on-failure (crash-only; smooth handles state-preserving quick restart). dinit upstream configure default = restart ALWAYS — always set restart EXPLICITLY. Also: unit source-file renames need sha512sums regenerated IN source= order; upstream GitHub tag archives are immutable-UNRELIABLE (repos get renamed/re-published — DankMaterialShell -> dux-shell live case); pin by commit.

Sweep follow-ups 2026-11-08: (1) xdg-desktop-portal-dinit RETIRED — unit named as portal frontend ran /usr/libexec/xdg-permission-store --replace (wrong binary + wrong scope: frontend/document-portal/permission-store are per-SESSION daemons, Alpine ships NO initd, FeralOS session coverage complete in xdg-desktop-portal-user-dinit, unit referenced nowhere). (2) dms-shell r5 commit-pinned: tag v1.6.2 → commit 2db7646fe3ab47fddfdb8723f2da07d61a0d47ac; tag-archive sum 7ccb2361 == old pin; commit-archive content byte-identical (2014 files); new sum e6ce10a4; builddir → dux-shell-$_shellcommit; dux-qml-common was ALREADY commit-pinned. (3) 6 uncertain units finalized via upstream sources: at-spi RESIDENT (smooth=true kept), flatpak-oci-auth + flatpak-system-helper (10-min IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS), nm-dispatcher (10s idle, no --persist), nm-priv-helper (2s IDLE_TIMEOUT_MSEC), plasma-localegen-helper (30s QTimer) all smooth=false flips; bumps flatpak-user-dinit r4, flatpak-dinit r5, networkmanager-dinit r7, plasma-workspace-dinit r3. (4) dbus-dinit r10 documents crash-only policy; ADR-009 Amendment 2026-11-08 supersedes 'nobody restarts the bus'. All 6 APKBUILDs abuild verify green in docker; CI 42501030405 green 11min; Pages carries all 6 bumps (dms-shell-1.6.2-r5, networkmanager-dinit-r7, dbus-dinit-r10, flatpak-dinit-r5, plasma-workspace-dinit-r3, flatpak-user-dinit-r4), retiree pruned from Pages+APKINDEX. Backlog flags: xdg-document-portal-dinit + xdg-desktop-portal-wlr-dinit same orphan class; 14 other packages still tag-pinned (cli11 dinit-chimera dms-window-buttons matugen polkit quickshell raffi sd-tools stasis turnstile ursine veila wayle wl-clipboard-rs).

Source-pinning policy FINAL: every aports GitHub source pins to a TAG archive (refs/tags/), NEVER a commit archive — sha512 = integrity guard, tag = version contract; a checksum failure after an upstream tag re-publish IS the signal to review + port the fix (commit pins would silently keep old bytes forever). Executed: dms-shell r6 reverted to dux-shell v1.6.2 (re-fetch sum == the originally validated 7ccb2361; tag bytes unchanged) + dux-qml-common v1.6.0 (commit 26396ce contained; delta = one trivial VERSION bump; sum b589592); feralos-dbus-audit r6 → feralos tag dbus-audit-0.1.0 (cut + pushed at commit 3dd71ec; archive content == commit archive, diff -r rc 0; sum e1c39f20). Inventory: 17 archive sources / 16 packages ALL refs/tags, zero commit pins, zero release-asset URLs, zero non-GitHub sources, zero moving targets. Docs: aports README 'Source pinning policy' section + feralos AGENTS.md live section + docs/aports-pinning.md mirror.
